title: Great Pyramid as a giant power plant
summary: Joe Rogan tells of Great Pyramid as a giant power plant, about c. 2500 BC at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh the Christopher Dunn stuff like where he thinks it was a gigantic power plant.

related.note: Both are about the true purpose of the Great Pyramid. Dunn says it was a power plant and Hancock says it was a portal rather than a tomb, so the two claims compete.
